definition: The existing StoppingPoints.NecessaryFact says the same fact is true at every world accessible from a. It need not be actually true without actual reflexivity; it is not a necessarily existing bearer or essence. GroundingBaseline exports that existing declaration rather than adding another necessity notion.
note: Analyst framework for #545, not independently established metaphysical applicability. See docs/notes/grounding-baseline-545.md for examples, exclusions, structural properties and strongest rival replies.
